method: Variable-width abrasive cuts with longitudinal meander/depth variation; finite rounded scratches and partially burnished finishing passes. Multi-scale unresolved surface statistics vary roughness without painted dirt.
subpixelFinish: Finer unresolved abrasive microstructure is represented by roughness rather than unsupported height detail.
roughnessCoarseRefinement: Reduced from .031 after live photographic-environment brace review; physical height cuts and F0 are retained.
coordinateConvention: U is image-right; V is image-up. Physical-array rows increase +V, raster arrays are flipped vertically once.
normalDerivation: OpenGL (-dh/dU, -dh/dV, 1), normalized; periodic centered differences in millimeters. No artist normalScale multiplier is baked.
